items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Pete played clarinet. Albert played trumpet. And Adolphe, he played piano... Those brothers? Well Pete, he went to, uh, Pete's supposed to be in Europe right now. And Albert, it was the last time I heard he was at St. Louis.

ctx.x: Oh. What instruments did they play?

Pete played clarinet. Albert played trumpet. And Adolphe, he played piano, but Adolphe got killed in an automobile accident. All right. What kind of a set of drums did you have when you started? How big a bass drum? You just showed us your bass drum. I had the same size drum that I have now, 14 by 28. And I just set a Ludwig drum. But those are not the same drums. What thing is this? That's a Ludwig. That's a Ludwig drum. Yeah. You say it has a good tone, better than most tones. Yeah, it's wonderful. It has a…
You're one of the few drummers that can seem to play a melody on the drums. You get a melody out of them, and that wasn't solo on Tiger Ray.
